sources.caveat: Single-model analysis; no cross-validation from independent perspective

findings.finding: 5 of 19 store source files have zero test coverage: backendSlice, conversationSlice, loadingSlice, skillsSlice, workspaceSlice. Additionally settings/state.ts uncovered.
7 of 23 MCP endpoints completely untested: learning, m10-revision, m10-style, m11-worldview, plugins, workspace, analysis
Hooks directory has 37 source files but only 10 test files — 27% coverage ratio, significantly below acceptable threshold
9 of 20 store tests are happy-path only (no error handling, edge cases, or boundary conditions). 2 endpoint tests also shallow.
Only 6 E2E tests across entire codebase. 7 core business flows lack end-to-end validation. No Playwright/Cypress setup.
Only 13 integration tests total (4 frontend, 9 backend). Frontend-backend API bridge validation limited to 6 contract tests checking shape only.
Estimated line coverage ~68%. Fails production standard (80%) and release standard (75%). Passes MVP (60%) marginally.

Companion test pattern (.additional.test.*, .branches.additional.test.*, .tail-additional.test.*) effectively extends coverage. workflow/ at 96%, narrative/ at 93% — highest coverage directories both use companion pattern extensively.

technical_solutions.solution: Apply companion test pattern (.additional.test.*) to uncovered store slices and endpoints
technical_solutions.problem: 5 store slices and 7 endpoints have zero test coverage
technical_solutions.rationale: Companion pattern proven effective in workflow/ and narrative/ modules (>90% coverage); matches existing codebase conventions
technical_solutions.next_action: Implement for skillsSlice and conversationSlice as P0 priority

technical_solutions.solution: Add E2E test suites for top 3 critical business flows (foreshadow lifecycle, character analysis, quality evaluation)
technical_solutions.problem: Core business flows have no end-to-end validation
technical_solutions.rationale: These 3 flows exercise the widest surface area and represent highest user impact if broken
technical_solutions.next_action: Design E2E test plan in Phase 4 roadmap

technical_solutions.solution: Deepen shallow store tests with error and edge case coverage
technical_solutions.problem: 9 of 20 store tests cover only happy-path
technical_solutions.rationale: Store layer is state management backbone — error handling gaps mean UI crashes on failure modes
technical_solutions.next_action: Add .branches.additional.test.* files for top 5 shallow store tests

convergent_themes: Store layer is the weakest coverage link
MCP endpoints have significant untested surface
Companion test pattern is the most effective coverage strategy
